activity.notes: Hatshepsut ruled Egypt as pharaoh in a co-reign with Thutmose III. ATLAS records the standard Metropolitan Museum chronological window of approximately 1479–1458 BCE.

sources.title: The Female Pharaoh Hatshepsut — The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.citation_text: The Metropolitan Museum identifies Hatshepsut as pharaoh and dates her joint reign with Thutmose III to approximately 1479–1458 BCE.
